strings.MDD＝（88,000 ÷ 110,000）− 1＝−20% 回撤金額＝110,: MDD = (88,000 ÷ 110,000) − 1 = −20%. Drawdown amount = 110,000 − 88,000 = 22,000. Recovery period = the number of periods required to return to 110,000 after the trough.
strings.Running peak Gₜ＝max(V₀, V₁, …, Vₜ) Drawd: Running peak G_t = max(V_0, V_1, …, V_t); Drawdown_t = V_t ÷ G_t − 1; MDD = min(Drawdown_t); Drawdown amount = peak equity − trough equity
strings.價格報酬 rₜ＝Pₜ ÷ Pₜ₋₁ − 1 累積報酬＝∏(1＋rₜ) − 1 年:
Price return r_t = P_t ÷ P_{t-1} − 1
Cumulative return = ∏(1 + r_t) − 1
Annualized return = (Ending equity ÷ Beginning equity)^(periods per year ÷ number of observation periods) − 1
strings.風險距離（多頭）＝Entry − Stop 報酬距離（多頭）＝Target −: Risk distance (long) = Entry − Stop; Reward distance (long) = Target − Entry; R:R ratio (risk–reward) = Reward distance ÷ Risk distance; Expected value per trade (R) = Win rate × Average profit (R) − (1 − Win rate) × Average loss (R)
